### ⚠️ Finding — AMP fp16 must be disabled locally

fp16 runs at **0.13×** fp32 throughput on this GPU — i.e. several times *slower*, reproducibly.

The GTX 1650 (TU117) ships **without tensor cores**, so there is no fast fp16 GEMM path and cuBLAS falls back to a slow kernel. This directly contradicts `PROJECT_PLAN.md` §12.3, which specifies *"Precision: AMP fp16"* for the minimum configuration.

**Revised guidance:**

| Tier | Precision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Local (GTX 1650) | **fp32** | fp16 costs 5-8× compute for a memory saving we can get more cheaply by lowering batch size |
| Cloud (P100 / T4) | **AMP fp16** | T4 has tensor cores; P100 has a fast fp16 path. Re-run this benchmark there to confirm |

Cached features stay `float16` **on disk** (Plan §D) — that is storage, not compute, and is unaffected. Cast to fp32 on load.

Precision must therefore be a **config field**, not a constant, so the same code is correct in both tiers (decision PF-1 / task X-2).
